title: Battle of Waterloo
description:
The **Battle of Waterloo** was fought on June 18, 1815, near Waterloo in present-day Belgium. It marked the final defeat of Napoleon Bonaparte.

The French army under Napoleon was defeated by the combined forces of the Duke of Wellington and the Prussian army under Gebhard von Blücher. The battle ended the Napoleonic Wars and Napoleon's rule as Emperor of France.

Napoleon was subsequently exiled to Saint Helena, where he died in 1821.
